label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Renee, here's my rundown for the admin meeting. Use whatever helps.

GAME
We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night. That locks up 2nd in the region.

- Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before us coaches even got together to talk about it. That one meant a lot to me.
- Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 TDs. His long TD came in the 3rd quarter, and our line pushed them 5 yards back on that whole drive. Best I've seen them block all year.
- Our defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

PLAYOFFS
We got a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley in the first round this Friday, Nov 13, at 7pm at Ridge Field. Presale tickets start Tuesday at the ticket office. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows. We'd love to see a big crowd, so anything admin can do to get the word out to staff and families would be great. Boosters still need 6 more people on concessions for that night, and their sign up sheet is going around.

ACADEMICS
The 9 week grade check is in. All 52 kids on the roster are eligible and nobody is on the list. That's on Tonya Greer, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason our grades are clean, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs. If anybody gets a shout out in the board report I want it to be her.

BOOSTERS
The Boston butt sale came in way over goal. They sold 208 butts and raised $6,240 against a $4,500 goal. Carla Mims ran it. The money is going toward new sideline headsets. Hargrove's Meat Market did all the smoking at cost, and they deserve a thank you too.

BUSES
I haven't forgotten about the 5 days out rule. If we win Friday and have to go on the road, I'll get the bus request to you as soon as we know where we're headed.

Thanks Renee. Let me know if you need anything else before noon.

Coach Tillman
